userManualData.dashboardBody:
A general overview of operational status: people assigned today vs.
ideal headcount, coverage by area, today's movements, FFT indicators
(Efficiency/Delays/Production/Compliance), and distribution charts
by shift/area. At the very bottom, the "Plant issues (today)" card
summarizes today's delays and equipment problems live. It is read-only
-- to assign or move personnel, use Work Center.
userManualData.centroTrabajoBody:
The main module. Three tabs:

- Stations: an operational map of all work centers (Lines 0-10, Palletizing,
  Accessories, Supplies, Midea/High Value, Conveyor, and support areas).
  Click any area to see the detail of its positions and who occupies them.
- Personnel: a search tool for people and their current location, with
  movement history.
- Terminated: personnel marked as terminated (no longer part of the
  active roster) -- they are never deleted from the system, only marked inactive.

Inside each area's detail view you can: register someone at an open
position, move someone between positions, release a position, and (if your
role allows) configure that area's positions. A move requested by a LIDER
requires approval from a SUPERVISOR or ADMINISTRADOR before it takes
effect -- that pending request stays flagged until it is resolved.
userManualData.usuariosBody:
Visible only to those with the "Users" module enabled (typically
ADMINISTRADOR). Create/edit/deactivate accounts, reset passwords,
and configure which modules each role or individual person can see
(individual overrides take precedence over the role's general permission).
userManualData.registroPersonalBody:
A screen designed for quick check-in on a tablet/floor: search for a
person and assign them to an open position in a few taps, without going
through the full Work Center detail view.
userManualData.kpisBody: Key indicator (KPI) table imported as-is from the company's official spreadsheet, grouped by area, with the same color coding as the original spreadsheet's conditional formatting.
userManualData.asistenciaBody: Personnel by work area with today's attendance: present, pending, absences and coverage by area, with a search bar and drill-down to each person.
userManualData.auditoriaBody: Three real audit types: Process Audit (real per-station checklist, currently available for Labeling), 5S Audit (40-criteria checklist, radar and monthly evolution by area), and Equipment Walkthrough (checklist of the 9 physical equipment types from Equipment Control, with an immediate result). Security Audit is still under construction.
userManualData.faq1Question: Why can't I see a module I used to see?
userManualData.faq1Answer: An ADMINISTRADOR can change at any time which modules your role or your specific account can see, from Users -> Permission Management. If you think this is a mistake, ask them to review it there.
userManualData.faq2Question: What does it mean when someone is missing a "station"?
userManualData.faq2Answer: This happens when the station that person was assigned to no longer exists in the area's current configuration (for example, an administrator deleted or renamed it). The person is never removed from the system -- they appear under "Personnel without a station" until someone reassigns them to an actual position.
userManualData.faq3Answer: Movement history is never deleted or edited (it is a permanent record). To correct a location, you simply make a new movement -- the system does not "rewrite" the past.
userManualData.evaluacionesBody: History of completed 5S and Process audits, with a detailed result and comparison against the previous audit for the same area/station.
userManualData.demorasBody: Real downtime log: pick an area/line, a station (optional), a cause (catalog of 14 options: waiting, system/internet failure, machine failure, missing materials/accessories/cushion/protector/bags/tools, defects, different gradings, duplicate, model), duration in minutes, shift, and an optional note. Delays of 4 minutes or more are marked "Reportable" in the history. The LIDER role only sees the logging form, without the recent-records history.
userManualData.controlEquipoBody: Real physical equipment status log (printer, heat gun, cushion gun, tablet, radio, scanner, tape machine, strapping machine, pallet jack): pick the type, area/line, station (optional), an optional identifier (e.g. "Printer 3"), and the status (Operational, Damaged, Under repair, Decommissioned), plus an optional note. The history shows every record with its status.
userManualData.horaPorHoraBody: Pick date, shift, and area/line; the first time, set the standard rate and the loss unit (pieces or minutes, a single one per shift), and the system generates every hour automatically. Capture works directly in the table, like a spreadsheet: click a cell, type the value, Enter moves to the next hour, Tab moves across columns -- it autosaves, no "Save" button. Besides actual production, each hour has one column per loss cause configured for THAT area (Production lines/Supplies/Accessories/Midea/Palletizing each have their own catalog -- an administrator configures them from "•••" → "Configure causes") plus an observations column. Gap, compliance, the KPIs, the cumulative chart, and the Pareto of causes all update automatically with every capture. "View history" shows past shifts by date/shift/area with a read-only hour-by-hour detail, and "Export Excel" generates a file with 2 sheets (Hourly Production and Summary), matching the original physical control format. "Finalize shift" makes it read-only (an administrator or supervisor can reopen it if needed).
userManualData.sortingBody: Works exactly like Hourly Production (same standard rate, same loss unit, same spreadsheet-style capture with autosave, same 11 fixed loss columns, same Pareto/history/Excel export), but it's a separate module with its own permission -- unlike Hourly Production, Sorting has no area/line selector because Sorting itself is a single fixed area.
userManualData.organigramaBody: Personnel org chart. Still under development -- for now it only shows up in the menu.
userManualData.planeacionBody: Production planning. Still under development -- for now it only shows up in the menu.
userManualData.rechazoInternoBody: Internal production rejection registry/catalog. Still under development -- for now it only shows up in the menu.
userManualData.ppmInternoBody: Internal PPM's registry/catalog (parts rejected per million manufactured). Still under development -- for now it only shows up in the menu.

userManualPage.title: User Manual
userManualPage.introText: How to use Work Center FFT.

developerManualData.architectureOverview:
Work Center FFT is a production floor personnel management app: who is
assigned to which station today, movement history, attendance, import of
the official headcount template (Excel), and role/module-based permissions.

Current stack: React 18 + Vite (JS, permissive tsconfig since Compliance
Phase 1) + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui + Drizzle ORM on top of Postgres (Neon)
+ in-house authentication via a signed cookie (JWT) + real i18n
(react-i18next, es-MX/en/zh-CN). Main deployment on Coolify (direct push
to main on the "mi2" remote, no preview -- centro-de-trabajo.mi2.com.mx);
Vercel/GitHub remains a secondary remote.

Data layer (server-lib/db/): schema.js + relations.js were generated with
"drizzle-kit introspect" directly against the real database (never written
by hand) -- it grows via one-off additive migrations (see drizzle/*.sql +
scripts/apply-*-migration-*.mjs; drizzle-kit generate/migrate don't run in
a non-interactive shell). client.js exports "db" (a singleton) plus every
table, for direct import from any server file.

Frontend (src/): pages organized by module in src/pages/<module>/, session
state in src/state/auth.jsx, personnel data layer in
src/data/personnel/ and src/data/production/ (area/shift catalog,
imported base snapshot, etc.).

Dynamic sidebar (shared/moduleRegistry.js + src/layout/navigationConfig.js):
MODULE_REGISTRY is the ONLY source of truth for which modules exist
(key/name/icon/permission) -- adding a module never requires touching the
sidebar's JSX. Each module carries an explicit `group` or gets inferred by
keyword (inferNavigationGroup, no AI). Plant-operational modules are
classified with the PQCDSM methodology (Productivity/Quality/Costs/
Delivery/Safety/Personnel, each with a letter+color badge);
Administration/Resources/System stay outside PQCDSM as support sections.
Real pipeline: user -> permissions -> visible modules -> classification ->
sidebar (never the other way around) -- a category with no visible modules
simply doesn't appear.

Backend (api/, server-lib/): every file under api/**/*.js is a serverless
function (the same code serves Vercel or Coolify). server-lib/api-routes.js
(mountApiRoutes) is the ONLY place that registers every route -- a new
endpoint ALWAYS requires an import + app.get/post there, there is no
file-based auto-discovery. server-lib/dev-server.js/prod-server.js mount
those same functions on Express (local dev via concurrently "vite" +
"node server-lib/dev-server.js"; production via PM2/pm2-runtime, see
ecosystem.config.cjs). server-lib/auth.js handles authentication
(getSessionUser) and the 3 authorization wrappers (requireAuth/
requireRole/requireModuleAccess) that wrap nearly every endpoint.

IMPORTANT (real Node ESM, no bundler, unlike the Vite-powered frontend):
any import under api/**/src/data/**/server-lib/** MUST include the
explicit .js extension -- an extensionless import (Vite-style) only
breaks in production/dev-server (Node can't resolve it), never in `npm
run build` (Vite does tolerate extensionless imports). A real bug of this
kind took down all of production on 2026-09-04 (502 Bad Gateway) -- always
verify by running `node server-lib/prod-server.js` locally before calling
a backend change done, not just `npm run build`.

Maintenance scripts (scripts/*.mjs): one-off idempotent migrations
(soft-deleting obsolete stations, never a physical DELETE) and
scripts/seed-personnel.mjs, which syncs Workstation with the pure generator
src/data/personnel/workstations.js. scripts/verify-line-logic.mjs is the
project's pure logic verification suite (there is no Vitest/Playwright
yet) -- it is run after any change to catalog.js/workstations.js.
developerManualData.authOverview:
Authentication today: login by employeeNumber or username (there is no
email field in the User model), bcrypt-hashed password, an httpOnly cookie
named "fft_session" signed with JWT (8-hour session). getSessionUser always
re-queries the real User from the database on every request -- it never
trusts the role/status the token claims to have, only the userId.

Planned migration (see the credentials checklist): replacement with real
Nextcloud SSO (OIDC). The 25 files that call requireAuth/requireRole/
requireModuleAccess do NOT change with that migration -- only how req.user
gets populated in api/auth/login.js and api/auth/session.js changes.
developerManualData.dataDictionary_User_purpose: System access account (login) -- completely separate from Employee.
developerManualData.dataDictionary_Employee_purpose: The real floor personnel catalog, populated by the LAYOUT FFT.xlsx import.
developerManualData.dataDictionary_ImportBatch_purpose: Each import run of LAYOUT FFT.xlsx -- idempotent by fileHash.
developerManualData.dataDictionary_EmployeeImportSource_purp: Raw BASE/BAJAS row that originated or updated an Employee (traceability).
developerManualData.dataDictionary_Skill_purpose: Catalog of skills/activities (code = raw Excel code: LC, EM, L, PE...).
developerManualData.dataDictionary_EmployeeSkill_purpose: An employee's skill. Removing one is ALWAYS a soft delete, never a physical DELETE.
developerManualData.dataDictionary_BajaConflict_purpose: Admin review queue: a possible name match between BASE and BAJAS. Never resolves itself.
developerManualData.dataDictionary_EmployeeReconciliationCan: Admin review queue: a possible duplicate between an existing Employee and a new import row.
developerManualData.dataDictionary_ImportedAttendanceReferen: Raw ASISTENCIA code (A/F/I/V) exactly as it came from the Excel -- NOT related to the real Attendance table.
developerManualData.dataDictionary_Attendance_purpose: The real day-by-day roll call, generated by the app (not by the Excel).
developerManualData.dataDictionary_WorkArea_purpose: Physical work area (line, palletizing, accessories, etc.).
developerManualData.dataDictionary_Workstation_purpose: Physical position within a WorkArea. name is the real technical identifier (used by DailyAssignment/EmployeeMovement).
developerManualData.dataDictionary_DailyAssignment_purpose: Where each person is TODAY. Only one ACTIVE row per employee/day (partial unique index).
developerManualData.dataDictionary_EmployeeMovement_purpose: Movement history -- append-only; the API must never expose UPDATE/DELETE on this table.
developerManualData.dataDictionary_PendingMove_purpose: Movement request made by a LIDER, pending approval from a SUPERVISOR/ADMINISTRADOR.
developerManualData.dataDictionary_RoleModulePermission_purp: A ROLE's permission on a module (dynamic, editable from Users).
developerManualData.dataDictionary_UserModulePermission_purp: An individual user's override on a module. ALLOW/DENY takes precedence over the role's permission.
developerManualData.dataDictionary_RoleModuleAccess_purpose: LEGACY -- effectively replaced by RoleModulePermission, kept unused as a historical backup.
developerManualData.dataDictionary_DowntimeRecord_purpose: Delays log -- 1 row per real downtime event (append-only, never editable).
developerManualData.dataDictionary_EquipmentItem_purpose: Equipment Control log -- 1 row per status observation of a real piece of equipment (append-only).
developerManualData.dataDictionary_EquipmentAudit_purpose: "Equipment Walkthrough" header -- 1 row per complete checklist (by area/station).
developerManualData.dataDictionary_EquipmentAuditAnswer_purp: 1 row per equipment type reviewed within an EquipmentAudit.
developerManualData.dataDictionary_HourlyProductionSession_p: Header of an Hourly Production shift -- 1 row per real date+shift+area/line combination.
developerManualData.dataDictionary_HourlyProductionEntry_pur: 1 row per one-hour block within a session, with its frozen standard and captured actual production.
developerManualData.dataDictionary_HourlyProductionDowntimeC: Real loss-cause catalog, PER AREA (editable by ADMINISTRADOR) -- Production lines doesn't share causes with Supplies/Accessories/Midea/Palletizing.
developerManualData.dataDictionary_HourlyProductionIncident_: A cause's captured value for one specific hour (1 row per entryId+causeId).
developerManualData.dataDictionary_SortingSession_purpose: Header of a Sorting shift -- same schema as HourlyProductionSession, but areaId is always Sorting's fixed constant (no area/line selector).
developerManualData.dataDictionary_SortingEntry_purpose: 1 row per one-hour block within a Sorting session -- same structure and same 11 fixed loss columns as HourlyProductionEntry.
developerManualData.apiMap_personnel: The heaviest group: checkin, move, release, roster, area-history, approve/reject-move, employees, suppress/restore-baseline
developerManualData.apiMap_users: User account CRUD + reset-password + individual permissions (requireModuleAccess("/usuarios"))
developerManualData.apiMap_demoras: GET/POST for the Delays log (DowntimeRecord) -- gated by requireModuleAccess("/demoras")
developerManualData.apiMap_controlEquipo: GET/POST for the Equipment Control log (EquipmentItem) -- gated by requireModuleAccess("/control-equipo")
developerManualData.apiMap_equipmentAudits: GET/POST for "Equipment Walkthrough" (EquipmentAudit/EquipmentAuditAnswer) -- POST gated by "/auditoria", GET by "/evaluaciones" (same criteria as FiveSAudit/ProcessAudit)
developerManualData.apiMap_horaPorHora: Hourly Production sessions/entries (get-or-create with race handling, PATCH for standard/actual/loss-by-cause/status) + per-area cause catalog (GET/POST/PATCH, POST/PATCH ADMINISTRADOR-only) -- gated by requireModuleAccess("/hora-por-hora")
developerManualData.apiMap_sorting: Sorting sessions/entries -- same endpoints and same logic as Hourly Production, separate tables and route -- gated by requireModuleAccess("/sorting")
developerManualData.apiMap_dashboardPlantIssues: Today's aggregated summary for the Dashboard's "Plant issues" widget (Delays + Equipment Control)
developerManualData.apiMap_permissionModuleUsers: Which users have access to a module
developerManualData.apiMap_modules: List of modules enabled for the current user (useEffectiveModules)

changelogPage.title: Changelog
changelogPage.intro: Real change history for the project (same content as CHANGELOG.md in the repository).

changelogData.unreleasedDescription: Genuine (not token) compliance with the company's internal standard, to enable deployment on the private server (Coolify). See the Developer Manual for architecture details.
changelogData.addedBiome: Biome as linter/formatter (2 spaces, width 100, "recommended" preset).
changelogData.addedTsconfig: Permissive tsconfig.json (allowJs) — new code is now written in real TypeScript; existing .jsx is converted opportunistically.
changelogData.addedSentry: Sentry observability (frontend + backend), inactive until a real DSN is provided.
changelogData.addedManuals: Developer Manual (ADMINISTRADOR only) and User Manual, both linked from the navigation menu.
changelogData.addedChangelog: This Changelog page, an in-app mirror of CHANGELOG.md.
changelogData.addedDrizzle: Full Prisma → Drizzle ORM migration. Schema generated by direct introspection against the real database (18 tables/12 enums). The 25 API/server files and 11 maintenance scripts that used Prisma were ported one by one, with verified identical behavior.
changelogData.addedI18n: Real i18n (react-i18next). Full framework plus extraction of all visible app text into translation keys, with real content in Spanish, English, and Simplified Chinese. Persistent language selector, Spanish as the default language.
changelogData.addedTailwind: Full MUI → Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui migration. All 88 frontend files converted one by one; MUI fully removed from the project.
changelogData.addedCoolify: Deployment to Coolify (Phase 7): PM2 (pm2-runtime) + a dedicated Express server as the entrypoint outside Vercel. Live at https://centro-de-trabajo.mi2.com.mx since 2026-09-01.
changelogData.changedFormat: Code formatting across the whole repo (Biome), with no behavior changes.
changelogData.pendingSso: Real Nextcloud SSO (OIDC), replacing the in-house login.
changelogData.v100Description: Production state before starting the stack migration. Full floor personnel management: daily station assignment, movements with approval (LIDER → SUPERVISOR/ADMINISTRADOR), attendance, personnel catalog imported from Excel (with review queues for termination/duplicate conflicts), role- and user-level permissions, and a 2D operational floor plan. Deployed on Vercel with automatic GitHub integration (desarrollo-personal → Preview, main → Production).
changelogData.addedPersonnelSync: Automatic personnel sync between SmartControl and the Employee catalog: new hires and terminations are reflected on their own every 30 minutes in production, with no manual entry.
changelogData.addedProcessManuals: Real process manuals (with images, extracted from the official manual) embedded in each line's "Process Sheet", for the Electrical Test, TV Cleaning, Packing and Labeling stations.
changelogData.addedFiveSAudit: Full 5S Audit system: a real 40-criteria checklist (5 categories), results radar, history, and monthly evolution by area.
changelogData.addedProcessAudit: Process Audit: a real 28-criteria checklist for the Labeling station, with the employee auto-filled from whoever is currently assigned there, and a result with a per-category score.
changelogData.changedPersonalTab: Compact redesign of the "Daily Status", "Quick Personnel Directory" and "Alerts & Pending" cards in the Personnel module.
changelogData.changedFiveSIntro: 5S Audit goes back to being "area-only" (no station/employee), with a visible Auditor field showing the session user.
changelogData.changedAreaColors: Lines with no assigned personnel now show in amber (previously gray/red), both in the Lines tab and the Operating Floor board.
changelogData.changedSidebar: The sidebar is reorganized into categories, generated dynamically from the module registry instead of a fixed list.
changelogData.changedOrganigramaVisionGeneral: Org Chart moves from M · Personnel to Overview (right below Dashboard), since it's a plant-wide transversal view rather than a PQCDSM family. Personnel Registration and Attendance stay unchanged in M · Personnel.
changelogData.changedLogoThemed: The logo now uses two real official assets depending on the active theme (light/dark), no CSS filters -- it switches immediately when the theme is toggled, no reload needed.
changelogData.changedAsistenciaAreas: "Personnel by Area" in Attendance no longer shows Quality, FFT Manager, or Supervisor as their own cards.
changelogData.changedCentroTrabajoLogo: The general brand logo is removed from Work Center's own header -- the sidebar already makes it always available.
changelogData.changedDemorasLiderView: The LIDER role now only sees the "Log a delay" form in Delays, without the "Recent records" history.
changelogData.addedCalidadManual: Real process manual (official Quality SOP) embedded in the "Process Sheet" for the Quality station across all WC LINEA.
changelogData.addedDemorasPlaneacion: Two new menu modules -- Delays and Planning -- marked "Under development", navigation only for now.
changelogData.addedOrganigrama: New Org Chart module (Overview) -- navigation only for now, marked "Under development".
changelogData.addedRechazoPpmInterno: Two new modules in Q · Quality -- Internal Rejection and Internal PPM's -- marked "Under development", navigation only for now. They'll be rework registries/catalogs reflected in the Quality KPIs down the line.
changelogData.addedDemorasRealFuncionalidad: Delays is no longer "Under development": a real catalog of 14 downtime causes, a logging form (area/line, station, cause, duration, shift), and a history view with a "Reportable" badge from 4 minutes onward. Does not include a technical block on "can't classify the next TV" -- that action lives in SmartControl/BinManager, a read-only external system from this repo.
changelogData.addedControlEquipo: New Equipment Control module: a real status log for physical equipment (printers, heat/cushion guns, tablets, radios, scanners, tape machine, strapping machine, pallet jack) by area and station, with history and a status badge.
changelogData.addedLevantamientoEquipo: "Equipment Walkthrough" in Auditoría: a third audit type, a real checklist of the 9 equipment types from Equipment Control, with an immediate result.
changelogData.addedPlantIssuesWidget: "Plant issues" widget at the bottom of the Dashboard: live summary of today's Delays and Equipment Control data (downtime, reportable delays, material issues, equipment with problems).
changelogData.addedHoraPorHora: Hourly Production module rewritten to exactly match the real production-control Excel sheet: standard vs. actual per one-hour block, gap and compliance always computed by the system, spreadsheet-style inline capture directly in the table (click, type, Enter/Tab) with per-field autosave, in a single unit (pieces or minutes) per shift, Pareto of causes, shift history, and Excel export (2 sheets: Hourly/Summary). The standard rate is frozen per hour at capture time -- changing it later never alters history. "Finalize shift"/"Reopen shift" always require explicit confirmation. Loss causes are no longer fixed: each area (Production lines/Supplies/Accessories/Midea/Palletizing) has its own independent catalog, editable by an ADMINISTRATOR from "•••" → "Configure causes" -- Production lines keeps the original 11 causes by default, the other areas start empty since they aren't production and have different stoppages.
changelogData.addedSorting: New Sorting module: the exact same format as Hourly Production (same gap/compliance/loss-by-cause formulas, spreadsheet-style capture with autosave), but as a fully separate module, tables, route (/sorting), and permission -- at the user's explicit request, "it's a distinct module." Unlike Hourly Production, Sorting has no area/line selector: it is a single fixed area, with no area filter in history and no area column in the table or Excel export. Zero automatic access for any role until an ADMINISTRATOR explicitly grants it.
changelogData.changedEvaluacionesPersonal: Evaluations moves from Q · Quality to M · Personnel, into the slot left open when Org Chart moved to Overview.
changelogData.changedPqcdsm: PQCDSM methodology: the sidebar regroups plant-operational modules into 6 families -- Productivity, Quality, Costs, Delivery, Safety, and Personnel -- each with a small letter-and-color badge next to the title. Administration/Resources/System stay as support sections, with no badge. A category with no real modules assigned yet doesn't appear -- it activates on its own as soon as the first module of that family is registered.
changelogData.fixedDarkMode: Dark mode: text that rendered black/invisible in several modules (Dashboard donuts, Centro de Trabajo KPIs, Audit results, etc.) now correctly inherits the theme color; chart tooltips that showed a fixed white background were also fixed. Light mode unchanged.
changelogData.fixedPlantTotalConsistency: The overall headcount total (Dashboard and the "Operating Floor" board) didn't match Attendance/"Area Summary" because each excluded a different set of support areas (Quality/FFT Manager/Supervisor/Trainer). Unified into a single rule app-wide: none of those 4 count toward the overall total.
changelogData.fixedHoraPorHoraDropdown: The Hourly Production "•••" menu wouldn't open (it rendered off-screen) because its trigger used a shared component that doesn't forward refs correctly -- aligned to the same pattern already used by the other 5 similar menus in the system.
changelogData.fixedHoraPorHoraDateTimezone: The active hour was never detected and the KPIs showed the full shift from the very first captured hour: the session date was being reinterpreted in local timezone instead of read as a calendar date, and the KPIs weren't wired to the already-existing "up to the current hour" calculation. "Shift summary" and the Excel export still show the full shift, as requested.
changelogData.changedLogo: Final real logo: the complete official image (icon + "Centro de Control" + "CONTROL OPERATIVO", all drawn into the image itself) is used as a single asset on login, sidebar, and header -- never a separate icon+HTML-text composition. The redundant logo in the compact top bar was removed (the sidebar already shows it), and in dark mode the sidebar header renders as a full white brand strip instead of a tight box around the image.
